onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event from the beginning of the first datapoint. Negative onsets account for events before the first stored data point.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds from onset. Must be zero, positive, or 'n/a' if unavailable. A zero value indicates an impulse event.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: Integer event ID assigned per file by the BIDS writer (MNE-BIDS) to each distinct trial_type; it is not the source stim code (see trial_type) and may differ between files.

trial_type.Description: Source stim code as 'stimcode-<N>', N = value of the source 'stim' vector (gestures.zip:gestures/data/bp/bp_rh_lh.mat). Each event spans one constant segment of the stim vector (onset at the sample where the code changes; duration until the next change). The full vector is kept verbatim in the STIMCODE channel.

Levels.stimcode-5: right fist close/open (source stimtext entry 5; the gestures README (SDR zk881ps0522) lists these as codes 1-3, but this source file uses codes 5-7 whose stimtext entries read right/left/both); on-screen cue text in source variable stimtext{5}: 'right'
Levels.stimcode-6: left fist close/open (source stimtext entry 6; the gestures README (SDR zk881ps0522) lists these as codes 1-3, but this source file uses codes 5-7 whose stimtext entries read right/left/both); on-screen cue text in source variable stimtext{6}: 'left'
Levels.stimcode-7: close/open both fists (source stimtext entry 7; the gestures README (SDR zk881ps0522) lists these as codes 1-3, but this source file uses codes 5-7 whose stimtext entries read right/left/both); on-screen cue text in source variable stimtext{7}: 'both'
